Theorem
[four-dimensional positive-isotropic-curvature classification] Source: cao-zhu 1. Theorem 7.4.5\group Canonical-Neighborhood Induction

A compact four-manifold with no essential incompressible space-form and with a metric of positive isotropic curvature is diffeomorphic to $\mathbb {S}^4$, or $\mathbb {RP}^4$, or $\mathbb {S}^3\times \mathbb {S}^1$, or $\mathbb {S}^3\widetilde{\times }\mathbb {S}^1$ $($the $\mathbb {Z}_2$ quotient of $\mathbb {S}^{3}\times \mathbb {S}^{1}$ where $\mathbb {Z}_{2}$ flips $\mathbb {S}^{3}$ antipodally and rotates $\mathbb {S}^{1}$ by $180^{0}),$ or a connected sum of them.
